response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse_rate FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_avg_pulse FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), above_overall AS (SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse_rate FROM telescope_averages ta CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ta.avg_pulse_rate > oa.overall_avg_pulse), second_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as second_avg_pulse FROM above_overall), final_telescopes AS (SELECT ao.telescref, ao.avg_pulse_rate FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN second_avg sa WHERE ao.avg_pulse_rate > sa.second_avg_pulse) SELECT AVG(ft.avg_pulse_rate) as mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(ft.avg_pulse_rate - oa.overall_avg_pulse) as avg_above_overall, AVG(ft.avg_pulse_rate - sa.second_avg_pulse) as avg_above_second FROM final_telescopes ft CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa CROSS JOIN second_avg sa
